summary: The recent surge in T1 Energy is being driven by a combination of a fundamental reset and a positioning squeeze. First, Q1 2026 results came in ahead of Wall Street expectations on production and sales, with management reaffirming an aggressive 3.1–4.2 GW 2026 output guide, which improves visibility on growth and margins in its solar/battery supply‑chain build‑out. Second, a large institutional stake disclosure then hit the tape on May 23, which the market is treating as validation of the long‑term story and has pulled in momentum/short‑covering flows, pushing the stock up nearly 50% over 20 days on 1.6x+ normal volume. Valuation screens (stock still quoted as below fair value and with very high forecast earnings growth) are reinforcing the move, but the immediate catalyst for the most recent leg higher is the institutional buying disclosure layered on top of the earlier earnings beat.
